## Product Images

Front view of the board.

## Description

The tiny computer is the newest board in the range, and it improves on the last one in almost every way that matters, from memory and networking to the speed of its processor and storage.

It comes with two gigabytes of memory, and you can run all of your favourite software on it once you have upgraded the operating system to the newest available release for the board.

The wireless networking has modular certification, which lets you put the board into your own product without paying for the same costly testing all over again, and that saves a lot of money.

Please note that this board is a significant redesign, so the cases, stands, and power supplies that you bought for the earlier boards will not fit, however carefully you try them.

You can still use your favourite accessories over the standard pins, and most of the add-on boards that sold well for the last model, including sensors, displays, and motors, work without changes.

The processor runs at a higher clock speed, draws more power when busy, and benefits from a small heat sink, especially in a closed case, on a warm day, or under a heavy load.

Two display outputs let you drive a pair of monitors at once, which is useful for signage, for development, and for anyone who likes to keep their documents, code, and terminal side by side.

The faster network port, the faster storage ports, and the extra memory make it a capable small server, whether you want to share files, run a home dashboard, or host a small site.

Every board is tested before it leaves the factory, comes with a printed safety sheet, and is covered by a limited warranty, though the box does not include a memory card, a case, or a cable.

## Technical Details

Weight: 46 grams.

Size: 85 by 56 mm.

Power: 5 volts at 3 amps.
